SERVICE AGREEMENT

This agreement is made between Acme Ltd and Beta Co.

1. Services. Beta Co shall provide the services described in Schedule A.

2. Payment. Acme Ltd shall pay KES 150,000 per month within 14 days of invoice.

3. Term. This agreement renews automatically each year unless terminated.

4. Termination. Either party may terminate this agreement by giving 90 days written notice.

5. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the other's information confidential.
